Most terms lack descriptions — the tool handles that gracefully (no trailing ` — `). The script is done.

**Built: `operations/engineering/fars/agentic/tools/update-indexes.js`**

What it does:
- Walks `library/domains/` recursively
- For each domain with `terms/` or `texts/`, generates `_index.md` with title + file listings (title/description from frontmatter)
- Domain-level `_index.md` gets links to terms/, texts/, and subdomains
- `--dry-run`: shows what would change
- `--domain PATH`: scopes to one domain
- Only writes when content differs (minimal diffs)

Summary line from full dry-run shows hundreds of updates/creates — the existing `_index.md` files are mostly bare stubs (`# Terms\n\nTerms and definitions related to X.`) that this replaces with actual content listings.

Hook note is in the file header comment: a PostToolUse hook on Write/Edit to `library/` should call this with `--domain` scoped to the affected domain.
